sheets.name: Sales Log
sheets.notes: One row per stylist per day. Service Commission equals Service Sales times Service Rate Pct divided by 100. Retail Commission equals Retail Sales times Retail Rate Pct divided by 100. Names are illustrative labels only.

sheets.name: Tier Calculator
sheets.notes: Tier Bonus is paid only when the period service total meets or exceeds the threshold. Payout uses the tier rate plus bonus when qualified, else the base rate. Illustrative numbers only.

sheets.name: Payout Statement
sheets.notes: Gross Pay equals Service plus Retail plus Tier Bonus plus Adjustments. Adjustments are negative for chargebacks or voids and positive for corrections. Voids Deducted is informational.

sheets.name: Dispute Log
sheets.notes: Log every question within 48 hours of payday. No formulas. Names are illustrative labels only.
